tasks.title: Establish the product-focus planning contract
tasks.goal: Create one post-V1 product authority, a detailed design and implementation plan, and a machine-verifiable execution queue without rewriting the locked V1 snapshot.
verification: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-product-focus-plan.ps1
pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/preflight-release.ps1 -NoRestore
acceptance: The locked V1 PRD remains unchanged.
The current queue has unique task IDs, valid dependencies, explicit authority, write sets, verification, evidence, and rollback fields.
Roadmap, tasks, documentation governance, spec, plan, and verifier point to the same canonical queue.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the product-focus planning, verifier, and documentation integration files.

tasks.title: Complete physics-expert Gate 1 for the six-item article set
tasks.goal: Obtain and record a physics-expert decision for all six article figures before any new scientific live-acceptance claim.
writeSet: artifacts or workspace run selected by the authorized reviewer
verification: Run the existing article-set verifier against the exact reviewed run identity.
Verify every accepted claim, evidence row, specification version, figure hash, reviewer identity, and correction record.
acceptance: Every item has an explicit accept or reject decision by the named physics expert.
Corrections are applied through the scientific authority chain and invalidate stale approvals.
No paid-provider call is made by this task.
tasks.rollback: Do not delete reviewer evidence; reject the affected specification version and create a new version for corrections.

tasks.title: Refresh live acceptance for the reviewed article set
tasks.goal: Run one bounded paid-provider acceptance from the exact Gate-1-approved identity and preserve checkpoint, provider, review, and Gate 2 evidence.
writeSet: docs/change-evidence dedicated to the authorized live run
verification: Verify request identity before dispatch or resume.
Run scientific contract, semantic, full-resolution visual, Gate 2, package, and hash verification.
acceptance: The user explicitly authorizes the paid run in the current task.
The run uses the Gate-1-approved identity and does not silently create a new request on resume.
The live report records cost, provider metadata, machine reviews, Gate 2, and immutable delivery hashes.
tasks.evidence: new bounded live-acceptance evidence path selected at execution time
tasks.rollback: Stop dispatch, return to fake mode, preserve partial receipts, and never describe a partial run as accepted.

tasks.title: Create lean quick, full, and release verification lanes
tasks.goal: Reduce ceremonial governance and source-structure testing while retaining high-signal domain, persistence, provider, scientific, package, and security gates.
verification: Run every new lane independently and record duration and included gates.
Prove that release preflight still builds, tests, formats, publishes, verifies the package, and checks diff hygiene.
acceptance: Quick lane runs focused build and tests without publish packaging.
Full lane runs repository build, full tests, semantic contract checks, and format.
Release lane runs package and release-only scans once without duplicate reference-parity work.
Reference evidence verifies structured decision fields rather than accepting any matching documentation edit.
Removed source-token assertions have equivalent behavioral, parser, or UIA coverage when the risk remains relevant.
tasks.rollback: Restore the previous scripts and tests; do not weaken scientific, secret, package-integrity, persistence, or paid-call guards.

tasks.title: Transfer WPF workflow state ownership out of the main window
tasks.goal: Create independent image-series and scientific workspace state owners while keeping the main window responsible only for global navigation and shared status.
writeSet: tests/ContentDeliveryStudio.Tests focused ViewModel and UIA tests
verification: Run focused navigation, command, busy-state, localization, reload, and selection tests.
Run a packaged UIA probe for both workspace modes.
acceptance: Image-series fields and commands are owned by one workflow ViewModel rather than passed through the main window.
Scientific fields and commands remain isolated from ordinary series state.
Main-window public workflow property count and touched-line surface decrease measurably.
No new coordinator is accepted unless it owns state or an external boundary.
tasks.rollback: Revert one workspace migration slice at a time while preserving public bindings through a temporary compatibility facade.

tasks.title: Retire unused module and remote-workflow runtime abstractions
tasks.goal: Remove production runtime code that only describes repository folders or a fake remote workflow, after proving no persisted or user-visible consumer requires it.
writeSet: tests/ContentDeliveryStudio.Tests module and remote workflow tests
verification: Search source, persisted schemas, package formats, docs, DI resolution, and user-visible commands for consumers.
Build, test, format, package, and launch the fake-first WPF app after removal.
acceptance: Repository folder paths are not product-domain runtime records.
No fake remote workflow adapter is registered in the desktop host.
Persisted compatibility is preserved or an explicit migration decision proves it is unnecessary.
No replacement abstraction is introduced without a real consumer.
tasks.rollback: Restore only the removed registration and contracts if a proven consumer is found.

tasks.title: Reduce pack infrastructure to the consumed scenario-profile surface
tasks.goal: Keep only pack metadata that is consumed by a user-visible route or persisted compatibility contract; represent ordinary courseware, poster, article, and social variants as scenario profiles.
verification: Inventory every runtime and persistence consumer before changing pack types.
Reload old workspace and pack fixtures, then run scenario planning and delivery tests.
acceptance: Scenario labels do not imply production maturity.
The WPF runtime no longer claims pack-driven composition while views remain hard-coded.
Legacy compatible packs still open through the minimum necessary adapter or documented migration.
Public marketplace, remote distribution, and speculative compatibility layers remain frozen.
tasks.evidence: new bounded pack-simplification evidence path selected at execution time
tasks.rollback: Restore the compatibility adapter and old fixture loading without reopening public pack expansion.

tasks.title: Enable approval-receipt and cost-bounded live queue execution
tasks.goal: Turn the durable fake-first queue into an explicitly approved real-provider production path without background dispatch or automatic replay.
writeSet: src/ContentDeliveryStudio.App image-series queue ViewModel and views
tests/ContentDeliveryStudio.Tests queue, persistence, provider and WPF tests
verification: Prove Prepare and every local mutation make zero provider calls.
Use a captured fake provider to validate receipt identity, invalidation, cost summary, dispatch order, pause, failure, and restart behavior.
Require separate user authority before one bounded paid live probe.
acceptance: A receipt binds exact task, prompt, provider, model, settings, operation count, and estimated cost.
Any material change invalidates approval before dispatch.
Pause prevents new dispatches without pretending an in-flight call was cancelled.
Restart never replays Running work automatically.
Live execution remains unavailable until current explicit paid authority is present.
tasks.evidence: new bounded live-queue evidence path selected at execution time
tasks.rollback: Disable live Execute, retain fake queue compatibility, and keep receipt/schema fields additive.

The UI hides or disables unsupported roles and explains the provider boundary.
Reference roles, source candidate, mask, instruction, provider operation, result, and approval appear in delivery provenance.

tasks.title: Harden scholarly source extraction for scientific figures
tasks.goal: Add structured reading-order, caption, formula, table, and citation recovery states for common text-bearing scholarly PDFs without silently accepting OCR-heavy sources.

tests/ContentDeliveryStudio.Tests scientific extraction and Gate 1 tests
verification: Evaluate candidate extraction components against a fixed legally reusable corpus before runtime adoption.
Run reading-order, caption, formula, table, missing-content, corrupted-order, and OCR-heavy fail-closed tests.
acceptance: Recovered structures have stable source locations and explicit recovery quality.
Required unrecovered formula, table, caption, or ordering blocks Gate 1.
No OCR or scholarly parser dependency is adopted without license, supply-chain, performance, packaging, and rollback evidence.
Existing accepted text-bearing fixtures remain compatible.
tasks.evidence: new bounded scholarly-extraction evidence path selected at execution time
tasks.rollback: Remove the new adapter, retain prior text extraction, and return structured unsupported or blocked results.

tasks.title: Add deterministic data-grounded scientific charts
tasks.goal: Render charts only from explicit structured data and an approved chart specification, with source hashes, transformations, units, and axes under human authority.
writeSet: new bounded scientific data/chart domain module
WPF data-source and chart-spec workspace additions
fixed data/chart corpus and mutation tests

Axes, units, filters, aggregation, uncertainty representation, and legend are visible before Gate 1.

Delivery preserves source data hash, chart specification, renderer version, reviews, and both human gates.
tasks.evidence: new bounded grounded-chart evidence path selected at execution time
